newsitem.title: CHINA: China province closes hundreds of polluting mills.
newsitem.headline: China province closes hundreds of polluting mills.

text.p: China's southern province of Guangdong has closed hundreds of polluting factories as part of a national environmental clean-up drive, officials said on Monday.

Authorities shut down 295 small paper plants, dye mills and metal smelters in September and would continue to close plants condemned as major polluters, an official of the Guangdong Environmental Protection Bureau said by telephone.
Guangdong had 343 such factories and the booming province had just shut down 86 percent of them, the official said.
"The factories we closed before September 30 were the bigger and more serious polluters," he said. "We will continue to close the rest of them."
China's environmental officials have closed thousands of small mills and factories across the country since early September, blaming them for causing serious ecological damage to rivers and lakes.
